items.title: Gold 2027 Graduation Trophy
items.alt: Gold trophy-shaped 2027 numerals on an ivory pedestal labeled Class of 2027, with a black cap resting on the seven.
items.description: A navy ribbon curls around the complete base beneath the reflective numeral sculpture and hanging gold tassel.

items.title: Welcome 2027 Rabbit and Tortoise Coloring
items.alt: A rabbit and a tortoise in party hats hold a Welcome 2027 banner in a black-and-white coloring illustration.
items.description: The rabbit’s long ears and the tortoise’s patterned shell frame a broad banner with open letters and small stars for coloring.

items.title: 2027 Rose Vine Coloring Lettering
items.alt: Large outlined 2027 numerals are wrapped in a rose vine, with a small bee above the seven.
items.description: Open petals, leaves and broad numeral spaces make the black-and-white floral year a detailed coloring composition.

items.title: Ready for 2027 Space Coloring
items.alt: A waving ringed planet rises above a Ready for 2027 round sign beside a small wheeled spaceship in black and white.
items.description: Stars surround the circular lettering while the toy-like spacecraft rests at the lower left with its cockpit and wheels fully outlined.

items.title: Class of 2027 Gown Coloring
items.alt: A graduation gown hangs beneath a mortarboard, with a Class of 2027 tag, in a black-and-white outline illustration.
items.description: Long pleated sleeves, a V-shaped yoke and a complete tassel distinguish the academic outfit while leaving broad areas for coloring.

items.title: Happy New Year 2027 Patchwork Coloring
items.alt: Happy New Year 2027 appears in patterned outlined bubble lettering beside a star wand and party hat.
items.description: Stitches, stars, dots and diagonal panels fill the large letters, with ribbons curling from the wand and pointed hat.
